title: chain(group([t1, t2]), group(), group()) crashes with AttributeError on NoneType
author: themavik
body_preview: ## Bug Description `chain(group([task1, task2]), group(), group())()` throws `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'parent'` because empty groups in the chain produce None results.  ## Expected Behavior Empty groups should be silently skipped in chain processing.  Related to #9772.

title: PeriodicTasks.update_changed() causes lock timeout with high concurrency
author: rodrigondec
body_preview: **Problem:**  The `PeriodicTasks.update_changed()` method uses `update_or_create()` which internally calls `select_for_update()`. This causes an exclusive lock on the single row (ident=1) in the `django_celery_beat_periodictasks` table.
